review_description: This company were good to deal with and prepared to provide all detailed information I requested (unlike one company which said "We are unable to respond to your inquiry as per your (request)..............good luck with your future installation" and several who seemed mainly interested in getting a signature on a contract without any discussion)Order has been placed, installation expected mid-February.Only one of your nominated companies contacted meI will be pleased to provide further information when the installation is completed and operating.
